arxiv-1601-04347.title: Scalar dark matter in an extra dimension inspired model
arxiv-1601-04347.creator: Roberto Lineros 1, Fabio Pereira dos Santos 2,3
arxiv-1601-04347.description: Abstract In this work we consider a singlet scalar propagating in a flat large extra dimension. The first Kaluza-Klein mode associated to this singlet scalar will be a viable dark matter candidate. The tower of new particles enriches the calculation of the relic density due effect of coannihilation.

arxiv-2010-08207.title: On Scalar and Ricci Curvatures This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on Scalar and Ricci Curvature in honor of Misha Gromov on his 75th Birthday. The full collection is available at https://www.emis.de/journals/SIGMA/Gromov.html
arxiv-2010-08207.creator: Gerard BESSON and Sylvestre GALLOT
arxiv-2010-08207.description: Abstract The purpose of this report is to acknowledge the influence of M. Gromov’s vision of geometry on our own works. It is two-fold: in the first part we aim at describing some results, in dimension 3 3 , around the question: which open 3 3 -manifolds carry a complete Riemannian metric of positive or non negative scalar curvature?

arxiv-2102-07088.title: Dark sky tourism and sustainable development in Namibia Volume: 367 Journal: Education and Heritage in the era of Big Data in Astronomy
arxiv-2102-07088.creator: Hannah S. Dalgleish 1,2, Getachew M. Mengistie 1, Michael Backes 1,3, Garret Cotter 2, Eli K. Kasai 1
arxiv-2102-07088.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Hannah S. Dalgleish 1,2, Getachew M. Mengistie 1, Michael Backes 1,3, Garret Cotter 2, Eli K. Kasai 1. Namibia is world-renowned for its incredibly dark skies by the astronomy community, and yet, the country is not well recognised as a dark sky destination by tourists and travellers. Forged by a collaboration between the Universities of Oxford and Namibia, together we are using astronomy as a means for capacity-building and sustainable socio-economic growth via educating tour guides and promoting dark sky tourism to relevant stakeholders.

arxiv-2201-10989.title: Uphill Roads to Variational Tightness: Monotonicity and Monte Carlo Objectives
arxiv-2201-10989.creator: Pierre-Alexandre Mattei, Jes Frellsen
arxiv-2201-10989.description: Abstract We revisit the theory of importance weighted variational inference (IWVI), a promising strategy for learning latent variable models. IWVI uses new variational bounds, known as Monte Carlo objectives (MCOs), obtained by replacing intractable integrals by Monte Carlo estimates—usually simply obtained via importance sampling.

arxiv-2202-04778.title: Quasi-triangle inequality for absolute correlation distance
arxiv-2202-04778.creator: Stanislav Dubrovskiy
arxiv-2202-04778.description: Abstract . We show that absolute correlation distance satisfies a K K -relaxed triangle inequality, with the best K = 2 K=2 . High correlation is not a transitive relation between datasets (considered as vectors in \mathbb{R}^{n} ): u correlated with v and w , does not in general imply v and w are correlated .

arxiv-2205-09851.title: The full range of uniform bounds for the bilinear Hilbert transform
arxiv-2205-09851.creator: Gennady Uraltsev, Michał Warchalski
arxiv-2205-09851.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gennady Uraltsev, Michał Warchalski. We prove uniform L p L^{p} bounds for the family of bilinear Hilbert transforms BHT β ​ [ f 1 , f 2 ] ​ ( x ) := p . ∫ ℝ f 1 ​ ( x − t ) ​ f 2 ​ ( x + β ​ t ) ​ d ​ t t \mathrm{BHT}_{\beta}[f_{1},f_{2}](x):=\mathrm{p.v.}\int_{\mathbb{R}}f_{1}(x-t)f_{2}(x+\beta t)\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{t} .

arxiv-2504-00304.title: Inverted Gaussian Process Optimization for Probabilistic Koopman Operator Discovery
arxiv-2504-00304.creator: Abhigyan Majumdar, Navid Mojahed, Shima Nazari
arxiv-2504-00304.description: Abstract Koopman Operator Theory has opened the doors to data-driven learning of globally linear representations of complex nonlinear systems. However, current methodologies for Koopman Operator discovery struggle with uncertainty quantification and the dependency on a finite dictionary of heuristically chosen observable functions.

arxiv-2506-12169.title: Voter model on heterogeneous directed networks
arxiv-2506-12169.creator: Luca Avena, Federico Capannoli, Diego Garlaschelli, Rajat Subhra Hazra
arxiv-2506-12169.description: Abstract We investigate the consensus dynamics of the voter model on large random graphs with heterogeneous and directed features, focusing in particular on networks with power-law degree distributions. By extending recent results on sparse directed graphs, we derive exact first-order asymptotics for the expected consensus time in directed configuration models with i.i.d. Pareto-distributed in- and out-degrees.

arxiv-2509-02985.title: Jacquet-Langlands correspondence for non-Eichler orders Thanks: The authors would like to thank John Voight for his helpful comments on this paper. The first author is partially supported by the NSF grant DMS #2302531; the second author was partially supported by Grant 113-2115-M-002 -003 -MY3 of th
arxiv-2509-02985.creator: Fang-Ting Tu, Yifan Yang
arxiv-2509-02985.description: Abstract . In this note, we give a concrete realization of the Jacquet-Langlands correspondence for non-Eichler orders of indefinite quaternion algebras defined over ℚ \mathbb{Q} . To be more precise, we consider a special type of index-two suborder of the Eichler order of level N N in the quaternion algebra with an even discriminant D D . 1.

arxiv-2510-03759.title: The magnon spectra of g-type altermagnet bulk CrSb
arxiv-2510-03759.creator: Murat Tas
arxiv-2510-03759.description: Abstract We present a calculation of the magnon spectra and chiral lifetimes of altermagnons in bulk CrSb using the many-body perturbation theory. The spin-split band structure is evident in the magnon spectra. Altermagnons attain an energy of 275 meV at the K point of the Brillouin zone.

arxiv-2601-03088.title: Epicyclic motion and accretion disk around a charged black hole in Einstein-ModMax theory with a quintessence field
arxiv-2601-03088.creator: Hamza Rehman, Sanjar Shaymatov, Tao Zhu
arxiv-2601-03088.description: Abstract We investigate the epicyclic motion of charged test particles and the associated quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs) around a weakly magnetized black hole surrounded by quintessence within the framework of Einstein–ModMax theory. We analyze the dynamics of charged particles on circular orbits and derive the corresponding radial and vertical epicyclic frequencies.

arxiv-2602-08680.title: Averaging Dynamics and Wong-Zakai approximations for a Fast-Slow Navier-Stokes System Driven by fractional Brownian Motion
arxiv-2602-08680.creator: Eliseo Luongo, Francesco Triggiano
arxiv-2602-08680.description: Abstract . We study a slow-fast system of coupled two- and three-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations in which the fast component is perturbed by an additive fractional Brownian noise with Hurst parameter ℋ > 1 3 \mathcal{H}>\frac{1}{3} . The system is analyzed using rough path theory, and the limiting behaviour strongly depends on the value of ℋ \mathcal{H} .

britannica-1911-wailly-noel-francois-de.title: Wailly, Noël François de (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-wailly-noel-francois-de.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-wailly-noel-francois-de.description: Article 'Wailly, Noël François de' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 28), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. grammarian and lexicographer, was born at Amiens on the 31st of July 1724. His life was spent in Paris, where for many years he carried on a school which was extensively patronized by foreigners who wished to learn French. In 1754 he published Principes généraux de la langue française, which revolutionized the teaching of grammar in France.

pmc-10552280.title: Photobiostimulation conjugated with stem cells or their secretome for temporomandibular joint arthritis in a rat model
pmc-10552280.creator: Rana El-Qashty, Osama A Elkashty, Eman Hany
pmc-10552280.description: BackgroundTemporomandibular joint (TMJ) arthritis is a debilitating, challenging condition and different methods have been implicated for its treatment. This study aimed to test the therapeutic potentials of low-level laser therapy (LLLT) associated with adipose derived stem cells (ADSC) or their derived secretome on a murine model induced arthritis.

pmc-10576884.title: Outbreak detection algorithms based on generalized linear model: a review with new practical examples
pmc-10576884.creator: Bushra Zareie, Jalal Poorolajal, Amin Roshani, Manoochehr Karami
pmc-10576884.description: Public health surveillance serves a crucial function within health systems, enabling the monitoring, early detection, and warning of infectious diseases. Recently, outbreak detection algorithms have gained significant importance across various surveillance systems, particularly in light of the COVID-19 pandemic. These algorithms are approached from both theoretical and practical perspectives.

pmc-10636180.title: Understanding the predictive accuracy of the InsuTAG index over other surrogate indices in normoglycaemic, non-obese males from Southern India
pmc-10636180.creator: Felix K Jebasingh, Shajith Anoop, Riddhi Dasgupta, Mathews Edatharayil Kurian, Aneez Joseph, Grace Rebekah, Venkataraghava Mohan, Nihal Thomas
pmc-10636180.description: We aimed to evaluate the predictive accuracy of InsuTAG index against M value of the hyperinsulinaemic-Euglycaemic clamp (HEC) procedure and fasting surrogate indices of insulin sensitivity/resistance in young, normoglycaemic, Asian Indian males. HEC studies were done in young (mean age 19.7 ± 1 years), non-obese (mean BMI 19.2 ± 2.

pmc-11364516.title: Immunotherapeutic advances in glioma management: The rise of vaccine‐based approaches
pmc-11364516.creator: Wireko Andrew Awuah, Muhammad Hamza Shah, Joecelyn Kirani Tan, Sruthi Ranganathan, Vivek Sanker, Kwadwo Darko, Pearl Ohenewaa Tenkorang, Bryan Badayelba Adageba, Arjun Ahluwalia, Vallabh Shet, Nicholas Aderinto, Mrinmoy Kundu, Toufik Abdul‐Rahman, Oday Atallah
pmc-11364516.description: BackgroundGliomas, particularly glioblastoma multiforme (GBM), are highly aggressive brain tumors that present significant challenges in oncology due to their rapid progression and resistance to conventional therapies. Despite advancements in treatment, the prognosis for patients with GBM remains poor, necessitating the exploration of novel therapeutic approaches.

pmc-11449754.creator: Cen Wang, Lilong Hou, Nan Jiang, Yu Wang, Xiaofen Mao, Ping Zhou, Yin Xia, Yuanyuan Wang, Chuyue Chen, Xinyu Yang, Qiang Luo, Jiao Pan
pmc-11449754.description: IntroductionEarthen sites are essential cultural relic resources, and site museums are a fundamental component of China’s cultural heritage protection. The mausoleum of the Qin Shi Huang Emperor is one of the largest, most peculiar, and richest imperial tombs in the world. The exhibition hall of the burial pit No.

pmc-12361552.title: Lysogenic control of Bacillus subtilis morphology and fitness by Spbetavirus phi3T
pmc-12361552.creator: Valentina A. Floccari, Helge Feddersen, Jaka Jakin Lazar, Virginie Grosboillot, Anna Munk, Paul Kempen, Robert Hertel, Tomaž Accetto, Ákos T. Kovács, Marc Bramkamp, Anna Dragoš
pmc-12361552.description: In lysogenic conversion, temperate phages can profoundly alter the phenotypes of their bacterial hosts. When studying the effects of SPbeta-like viruses on a Bacillus subtilis soil isolate, we observed that phage phi3T induced a stable and heritable acquisition of a spherical cell morphology, departing from the typical rod shape of its ancestor.

pmc-12463339.title: Effects of a Smartphone-Based Positive Reflection Diary on Work Engagement Among Japanese Workers: Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-12463339.creator: Masahito Tokita, Shuichiro Kobayashi, Daisuke Miyanaka, Nobuyuki Takate, Hiroyuki Nakano, Kazuki Takeuchi, Akihito Shimazu
pmc-12463339.description: BackgroundWork engagement is an important determinant of workers’ well-being. According to the job demands–resources model, personal resources are one of the key antecedents of work engagement. Enhancing personal resources leads to improved work engagement. Furthermore, reflecting positively on one’s achievements at work may enhance personal resources.

pmc-12742137.title: Using virtual twin-based AI models to detect atrial fibrillation and improve stroke outcomes [TAILOR]: a multicentre prospective cohort study
pmc-12742137.creator: Evi J van Kempen, Joan Jiménez-Balado, Jordi Jiménez-Conde, Frederick Jan Anton Meijer, Tim JF ten Cate, Abel Palacio-Gili, Sandra Ortega-Martorell, Brigitte Beltran Marmol, Anil Tuladhar, Eva Giralt-Steinhauer, TARGET Consortium
pmc-12742137.description: IntroductionAtrial fibrillation (AF) is the leading cause of cardioembolic stroke and is associated with increased stroke severity and fatality. Early identification of AF is essential for adequate secondary prevention but remains challenging due to its often asymptomatic or paroxysmal occurrence.

pmc-12978277.title: Complicações Esofágicas Graves após Ablação de Fibrilação Atrial: Ainda Devemos Nos Preocupar?
pmc-12978277.creator: Anibal Pires Borges, Carlos Kalil, Josep Brugada, José Plutarco Gutiérrez Yanez, Pablo da Costa Soliz, Marco Aurelio Lumertz Saffi, Anderson Donelli da Silveira, Maurício Pimentel, Anibal Pires Borges, Carlos Kalil, Josep Brugada, José Plutarco Gutiérrez Yanez, Pablo da Costa Soliz, Marco Aurelio Lu
pmc-12978277.description: ResumoA ablação da fibrilação atrial (FA) tem sido cada vez mais utilizada como uma estratégia eficaz para o controle do ritmo, resultando na redução da carga arrítmica, melhora da qualidade de vida e, em casos selecionados, diminuição da mortalidade. No entanto, por se tratar de um procedimento invasivo, envolve riscos inerentes.

pmc-13300619.title: Pulsed-field ablation using a penta-spline catheter in pulmonar vein isolation. Comparative analysis of general anaesthesia and deep sedation
pmc-13300619.creator: J Navarro Manchon, M Izquierdo De Francisco, O Cano Perez, J Navarrete-Navarro, C Arveras Martinez, G Rad Garcia, E Robles Perez, V V Soriano Alfonso, S Huelamo Montoro, J Llau Garcia, N Fernandez Ortiz, G Murillo Varona, M Gil Molina, L Martinez-Dolz, J Osca Asensi
pmc-13300619.description: BackgroundPulsed field ablation (PFA) is a novel non-thermal ablation modality introduced into the field of cardiac arrhythmias. Pulmonar Vein Isolation (PVI) is one of the most common interventions. Access to general anaesthesia (GA) can be a limitation for these ablations.PurposeDeep sedation (DS) can be similar to GA in terms of effectiveness (atrial arrhythmia-free survival) and safety (complications).

pmc-13482595.title: Isavuconazole as an adjunctive antifungal in the multimodal management of pulmonary aspergilloma and chronic cavitary pulmonary aspergillosis: a single-centre case series
pmc-13482595.creator: Meagan Deviaene, Elaine Dumoulin, Ranjani Somayaji, Christopher H. Mody, Christina S. Thornton
pmc-13482595.description: Symptomatic pulmonary aspergilloma and chronic cavitary pulmonary aspergillosis (CCPA) are typically managed with surgical resection or prolonged triazole therapy, but many patients are poor surgical candidates, and many cannot tolerate voriconazole. Our centre has previously described bronchoscopic debridement combined with antifungal therapy as a minimally invasive alternative for patients with accessible intracavitary fungal balls.

pmc-13596399.title: ACBP/DBI Neutralization Stimulates Anticancer Immune Responses by Upregulating Lamin A in T Cells
pmc-13596399.creator: Sijing Li, Carlos López-Otín, Maria Chiara Maiuri, Isabelle Martins, Guido Kroemer
pmc-13596399.description: IntroductionAcyl CoA binding protein (ACBP, encoded by the gene diazepam binding inhibitor, DBI) is a tissue stress hormone involved in pathological aging that mediates immunosuppression. The antibody-mediated neutralization of ACBP/DBI enhances anticancer immune responses in the context of chemoimmunotherapy. ACBP/DBI inhibition also upregulates the expression of the anti-aging gene Lmna coding for Lamin A in tumor-infiltrating T lymphocytes.
